jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included. You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time. You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits. Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. A

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Introduction At a glance Location & work model : Berlin, hybrid Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester ( KubeVirt ), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must Why this role is special Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. Your first 90 days You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next. Your mission Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard Plan capacity, performance and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations Your profile Must-haves: Kubernetes in production – built, not just used : you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm , RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role Lived SRE practice : SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call Hands-on experience with GitOps or comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): Harvester, KubeVirt , vSphere/ ESXi , OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN) Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler ) and capacity/cost planning Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs German language skills Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've act

jobs.description: <h2><strong>Kurz und knapp</strong></h2> <p>Als Online-Supermarkt ist das Herzstück unseres Businesses natürlich die Picnic App. Das Category Management Team sorgt dafür, dass unsere digitalen Regale in&nbsp;<strong>allen 6 Regionen</strong> perfekt mit lokalen Produkten ausgestattet sind.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Als WerkstudentIn bist du das operative Rückgrat unseres Teams. Du arbeitest eng mit Category, Brand und <strong>cross-funktionalen Teams zusammen</strong>, um Lieferengpässe zu lösen, Daten zu checken und dafür zu sorgen, dass unsere App für die KundInnen immer perfekt gepflegt ist.</p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Artikelerstellung &amp; Onboarding:</strong> Du übernimmst die Anlage und Erstellung neuer Produkte im System und stellst sicher, dass alle notwendigen Informationen vom ersten Tag an korrekt und für unsere KundInnen bereit sind.</li> <li><strong>Tool-Support &amp; Validierung:</strong> Du begleitest die Einführung und Nutzung unseres neuen Automatisierungstools. Als wichtige Instanz für die Qualitätskontrolle hinterfragst du Prozesse kritisch und stellst sicher, dass die Systemausgaben korrekt sind.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Produkt-Performance-Monitoring:</strong> Du behältst Verkaufs- und Bestandsanomalien genau im Auge. B. durch das schnelle Beheben von fehlenden Produktfotos oder unvollständigen Artikelinfos in der App.</li> <li><strong>Lieferkette &amp; Inbound-Abstimmung:</strong> Du unterstützt das Team bei täglichen kommerziellen Fragen zur Lieferkette und klärst Probleme bei der Produktanlieferung, um einen reibungslosen Ablauf in deinen Kategorien zu garantieren.</li> <li><strong>Teamarbeit:</strong> Du bietest starke operative Unterstützung über verschiedene Prioritätsstufen hinweg und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit dem gesamten Category-Team, um die täglichen Aufgaben optimal zu balancieren.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Fortgeschrittenes Bachelorstudium oder aktuell im Master in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, E-Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Volkswirtschaftslehre oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.</li> <li>Ein scharfes Auge fürs Detail, starkes logisches Denkvermögen und eine natürliche Neugier, um hinter die Kulissen zu blicken und operative Rätsel zu lösen.</li> <li>Exzellente organisatorische Fähigkeiten, eine proaktive Einstellung zur Übernahme von Verantwortung und Routine im Umgang mit täglichen Arbeitsabläufen.</li> <li>Eine echte Affinität für die Lebensmittelbranche und Begeisterung für die Arbeit mit neuer Software Systemen.</li> <li>Zeit, unser Team für <strong>16 - 20 Stunden</strong> pro Woche zu unterstützen.</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.</strong></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Darauf kannst du dich freuen</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Starte mit uns durch: </strong>Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalitä

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.</p></div><p><strong>Regional Field Chief Technology Officer</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: EMEA, Remote (Black Duck has entities in UK, Germany, Netherlands, France, Italy, Ireland, Finland, Sweden)</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Black Duck® meets the board-level risks of modern software with True Scale Application Security, ensuring uncompromised trust in software for the regulated, AI-powered world. Only Black Duck solutions free organizations from tradeoffs between speed, accuracy, and compliance at scale while eliminating security, regulatory, and licensing risks. Whether in the cloud or on premises, Black Duck is the only choice for securing mission-critical software everywhere code happens. jobs.title: Product Owner (all genders)
jobs.description: Deine Rolle bei uns Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung. In deiner Rolle als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte. Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert. Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen. Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen. Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung. Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick. Du schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritt, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten dafür, dass aus Konzepten funktionierende Lösungen werden. Anforderungs‑ & Stakeholder‑Management Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, hinterfragst und strukturierst sie und stimmst sie mit den relevanten Beteiligten ab. Du moderierst unterschiedliche Interessen und führst Entscheidungen herbei. Du begleitest Veränderungen und unterstützt dabei, neue Prozesse und Lösungen erfolgreich in der Organisation zu verankern. Beraten & Wissen vermitteln Du unterstützt bei der Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter digitaler Lösungen und Technologien. Du begleitest bei Bedarf Ausschreibungen, Angebotsbewertungen und Beschaffungsprozesse. Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf und unterstützt Anwender durch Workshops, Schulungen und geeignete Materialien. Was du mitbringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in digitalen Projekten, IT-Projekten, Produktentwicklung oder vergleichbaren Rollen mit eigener Verantwortung. Ein gutes Verständnis für Nutzer, Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge. Die Fähigkeit, Komplexität zu strukturieren und Entscheidungen herbeizuführen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mindestens C1). Hohe Reisebereitschaft (50% Anwesenheit am Standort Würzburg). Warum du bei uns richtig bist Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die nicht nur visionär klingen, sondern die Bauwelt tatsächlich smarter und zukunftsfähig machen – und das Ganze in Projekten und mit Kund:innen, die garantiert nicht langweilig werden. Dabei bist du von Anfang bis Ende mitten im Geschehen und hast ein Team an deiner Seite , das fachlich top ist, menschlich der Knaller und jeden Partybus das Fürchten lehrt. Wir glauben an Flexibilität statt Stechuhr, an Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement und an stabile Verhältnisse. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem familienfreundlichen Umfeld mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheidungen. Außerdem warten Team‑Get‑Aways, gemeinsame Events, Hansefit , ein dickes Benefits‑Paket und eine vernünftige Altersvorsorge auf dich. Wir bringen Kompetenz, Verantwortung, Weiterentwicklung und Humor perfekt unter einen Helm bringt.. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket. Work directly with users, product, and data , using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works. Prototype and test new AI capabilities , turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: What's it all about? The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity. At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions. Your impact As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts. The role Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team What we need from you You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required) Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus You communicate clearly and confidently in English What we offer Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro City center office location including home office option EGYM Wellpass membership support Educational budget for every employee Team events, summer & winter parties Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team Sounds good to you? Please submit your complete application including your salary expectations and earliest starting date. After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within a couple of business days. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Data Analyst, Storefront
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">The ideal candidate is deeply analytical, highly curious, and motivated by using data science to shape the trajectory of fast-scaling international storefronts. They are skilled at uncovering the underlying drivers of customer behavior, business performance, and product outcomes, and translating those insights into clear opportunities for growth.</p> <p>They thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where they are expected to move beyond reporting into proactive problem solving, experimentation, and strategic influence. This person is energized by building from zero-to-one, partnering closely with product, engineering, merchandising, and business teams to help new storefronts scale successfully.</p> <p>The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth in analytics and experimentation with strong business judgment. They are comfortable owning complex analytical initiatives end-to-end, influencing prioritization through data, and helping teams focus on the highest-leverage opportunities to improve customer experience and accelerate growth in emerging markets.</

jobs.title: Shopify Manager (m/w/d) - Conversion, Funnel & Shop-Entwicklung
jobs.description: Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern einen Shop wirklich verantworten? Bei NEOLYMP übernimmst du unseren Shopify-Shop in einer Phase, in der jede Optimierung sichtbar auf Umsatz und Wachstum wirkt – von der Landingpage bis zur letzten Zeile Liquid. Wer wir sind NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018. Wir entwickeln innovatives Fitnessequipment und ganzheitliche Trainingskonzepte für zu Hause – vom durchdachten Home-Gym-Equipment bis hin zu Online-Kursen, die Training, Motivation und Alltag zusammenbringen. Warum diese Rolle: Echte Verantwortung: Der Shop ist dein Bereich. Du entscheidest, was gebaut und getestet wird – und setzt es selbst um. Sichtbarer Impact: Conversion Rate, Bestellwert, Ladezeit – alles, was du bewegst, siehst du direkt in den Zahlen. Funnel-Fokus: Landingpages und Funnel-Seiten sind bei uns kein Nebenthema, sondern der Kern unseres Wachstums. Kein Silo: Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen und bist die Schnittstelle, die Ideen in fertige Seiten übersetzt. Regelmäßige Team-Events und ein motiviertes, modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke. Aufbau und Verantwortung eines eigenen Bereichs mit sehr viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Kurze Entscheidungswege und starke Startup-Kultur mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten auf dich zugeschnitten. Aufgaben Funnel & Conversion Du konzipierst und baust Landingpages und Funnel-Seiten, die Kund:innen intuitiv zur Bestellung führen. Du optimierst unsere Produktseiten verkaufspsychologisch – von Struktur und Aufbau bis ins Detail. Du baust Upsells, Bundles und Trust-Elemente ein, die den durchschnittlichen Bestellwert messbar steigern. Testing & Analyse Du planst A/B-Tests, wertest sie aus und leitest daraus die nächsten Maßnahmen ab. Du analysierst Conversion Rate, Customer Journey und Bestellwert laufend und erkennst, wo Potenzial liegt. Technik & Performance Du entwickelst unser Shopify-Theme eigenständig weiter und setzt neue Features direkt im Code um. Du hältst den Shop technisch auf Top-Niveau – Ladezeiten, Performance und SEO inklusive. Qualifikation Das ist uns wichtig Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit Shopify und ein sicheres Verständnis von Theme-Architektur und Liquid. Solide HTML- und CSS-Kenntnisse, um Features eigenständig umzusetzen. Ein starkes Marketing- und Conversion-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie verkaufsstarke Produktseiten, Landingpages und Customer Journeys aufgebaut sind. Erfahrung mit CRO, A/B-Testing und Heat Maps. Eine datengetriebene Arbeitsweise – du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen, nicht aus dem Bauch. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du setzt Dinge um, statt auf Zuarbeit zu warten. Das zählt für uns am meisten Lust und Motivation, dich weiterzuentwickeln und mit der Rolle zu wachsen. Die nächsten Meilensteine erreichen wir gemeinsam – dafür ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil. Nice to have Erfahrung mit Klaviyo oder vergleichbaren E-Mail-Marketing-Tools (Newsletter-Kampagnen, automatisierte Flows). So arbeiten wir: Remote first: Du arbeitest vollständig remote mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten – wir messen Ergebnisse, nicht Anwesenheit. Im Team: Du bist Teil eines hochmotivierten Teams aus Marketing, Performance und E-Commerce, das gemeinsam an einem Ziel zieht. Kurze Wege: Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Feedback ist direkt, und gute Ideen werden umgesetzt, nicht vertagt. Startup-Kultur mit Substanz: Wir sind seit 2018 am Markt, wachsen profitabel und haben trotzdem den Drive der ersten Stunde behalten.Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – und darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Kontakt: Josephine Steuer Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt uns stärker macht. Deshalb heißen wir alle Bewerbenden willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung. Bei uns gibt es keinen Dressco

jobs.description: Join EFT Mobility at a pivotal time as we revolutionize the future of electric transport, focusing on cutting-edge Electric Powertrain (EFT) solutions for high-reliability applications, including UAV power systems. We are a fast-growing, dynamic company where every engineer plays a direct, hands-on role in bringing our innovative, safety-critical products to life. If you thrive on ensuring product quality and solving complex, real-world problems, we want you on our team. We are seeking a highly skilled, execution-driven and hands-on Senior Industrialisation Engineer to bridge the gap between R&D and mass manufacturing for our battery packs and charger product lines. In this role, your primary focus will be the electro-mechanical process s teps and optimizations required to transform a functional prototype into a robust, high-yield, and highly scalable series product. Collaborating closely with our external Contract Manufacturers (CMs), you will co-architect the manufacturing lines, advise on critical assembly fixtures, and pave the way for a production ramp-up from pre-series batches into stable mass production. Collaborate regularly with Contract Manufacturers to optimise and release assembly line setup s, resolve technical build bottlenecks, and transition pilot runs into high-yield mass production. Conduct hands-on Design of Experiments in the lab and factory floor to establish locked-in process windows for automated gluing, thermal interface material (TIM) dispensing, and torque specs. Co-Own build failures together with the contract manufacturer to rapidly drive engineering adjustments and optimize first-pass yields. Page: 1/3 Oversee the EoL failures , analyse them and implement solutions to improve yield. What you bring to the team: Experience: 8+ years of experience as an Industrialization, Manufacturing, or NPI (New Product Introduction) Engineer, specifically driving the scale-up (upto 10-30k units) of battery modules/packs, power electronics enclosures, or high-reliability electromechanical systems. Technical Skills: Highly skilled in (mechanical) production processes, experience with failure analysis and production methods in a semi-automised production environment. Hands-on Workshop Mentality: A deeply practical engineer who thrives on the shop floor or in the prototype lab. You have no hesitation when it comes to standing at the line, personally assembling a battery module to understand a build bottleneck, or physically tearing down hardware to isolate a defect. Design Review & CAD Interpretation: Strong ability to navigate, interpret, and evaluate 3D CAD models and engineering drawings. jobs.description: Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara. We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure. By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future. Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe. Operations Coordinator As Neara scales globally, we're investing in the operational backbone that keeps a fast-moving, high-growth team running smoothly. To that end, we are hiring an Operations Coordinator for our London office: a hybrid role covering day-to-day administration, finance and customer invoicing support, team travel and activities, local HR requirements, onboarding, and hands-on support for commercial and marketing document work. This is a broad, hands-on role for someone who thrives on variety and detail, and who can move seamlessly between supporting an executive's calendar and inbox, keeping the finance and invoicing wheels turning, and pulling together a tender submission or marketing document. You will be the connective tissue that keeps the London/Europe team organised, compliant, and moving fast. What You'll Do: Act as a trusted right hand to regional leadership and team, anticipating needs and proactively solving problems before they become issues. Manage day-to-day administrative operations for the London/Europe team, including calendars, correspondence, and general executive support. Support financial administration - expense processing, invoice tracking, and liaising with finance at HQ. Own the customer invoicing process for the region: raising invoices, tracking payment status, chasing outstanding payments, and resolving billing queries. Organise team travel, offsites, and team activities, ensuring cost-effective and smooth logistics. Manage local HR requirements for the London/Europe team, including contracts, benefits administration, compliance with UK/EU employment regulations, and acting as first point of contact for HR queries. Coordinate basic onboarding for new hires: equipment, access, welcome logistics, and initial paperwork. Support the commercial team with tender or proposal submissions, and support marketing with collateral, event registrations, and vendor/supplier registrations. Who You Are: Experience in an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, Office Manager, or similar operations role, ideally in a fast-growing scale-up. Comfortable working across finance, HR, and admin tasks, with strong attention to detail. Experience with invoicing/billing processes and basic bookkeeping (Xero preferred). Familiarity with UK/EU employment and HR requirements, or a willingness to quickly get up to speed. Strong written communication skills - comfortable producing polished documents, proposals, and submissions. Highly organised, proactive, and able to juggle competing priorities Discreet and trustworthy when handling sensitive information. Comfortable in a fast-paced, ambiguous and international environment where processes are still being built. What We Offer: A collaborative, non-bureaucratic environment where innovation thrives and great ideas win regardless of title. Direct exposure to regional leadership, finance, HR, and commercial

jobs.description: An Introduction to Primer Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform. Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on. Watch our showcase > Read up on our $100m Series C Learn more about our culture > Which team will you be joining? You'll be joining Primer's Product Support team, reporting to our Support Lead. Support here isn't a cost centre bolted onto the side of the business — it sits inside Engineering as a full discipline, working alongside the developers who ship Primer's platform. Primer's customers are payments-technical merchants and partners, so the team spends its time in APIs, SDKs, and integration logs as much as in a ticket queue. The team runs 24/7 across Asia, Europe, and North America, and has grown to the point where one manager can no longer run it alone — which is why this role exists. You and our Support Lead will co-own Support's KPIs, metrics, and processes day-to-day. We run a deliberately low-ego, high-trust team — no dictated training plans, no micromanagement. You're joining at a genuinely interesting moment: due to the team's strong results and delivery on all our KPIs (especially Escalation Ratio and CSAT of 4.8/5), the team is about to expand into new territory as we expand the functions, partners and merchants that we support, so there's real room to shape where we go next. What will you be doing? Co-own Support's day-to-day KPIs, metrics, and processes, with direct accountability for your own group of Support Engineers. Step in when others are not available. Manage and coach a growing team of 5 Support Engineers spanning Asia, Europe, and the Americas — their delivery, growth, and performance. Drive operational excellence. Hold the team to a consistent bar on quality and pace. Perform QA, and review proposals and RFCs. Stay technically credible — dig into APIs, SDKs, and logs yourself, and step in to cover the team during periods of high demand, and on escalations. Own triage, escalation, and incident processes for your team, including leading and communicating through severe incidents and their post-mortems. Hold the team to a consistent quality and pace bar — review work, and coach rather than just monitor. Partner directly with Product and Engineering leadership to surface recurring issues, shape a realistic roadmap, and represent the voice of the customer. Identify knowledge and skill gaps across the team and facilitate the training to close them. Report on support performance and initiatives to Product & Engineering leadership, with real visibility across the company. What we're looking for Must-haves: 5+ years managing people, running a 24/7, distributed support operation — this is the one piece of experience that's essential for us Technical enough to still debug an API integration or work through logs yourself, not just manage people who do. A steady, consistent operator — someone reliable day in day out, not just on their best days. Strong written and verbal communicator, comfortable presenting to the wider company. Experience managing a major incident through to a post-mortem and RCA. Familiarity with ticketing systems like Jira, JSM, or Zendesk, and with ITSM and reporting/BI solutions. Nice-to-haves: 1-2 years in payments, or a strong B2B/SaaS background as a substitute. You may not like it here Support here isn't always exciting — you're managing people who spend their day in a ticket queue, looking at issues, troubleshooting and investigating. jobs.title: Patent Engineer (Life Sciences)
jobs.description: The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work , sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that. Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years . We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI. We’re at an inflection point: We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI. We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market . We’re just getting started. What you’ll be doing We’re looking for a patent professional with deep large-molecule life sciences expertise who can bridge product development, engineering and IP protection. You’ll work hands-on with pharmaceutical and biotech customers to design AI-powered patent solutions that understand the nuances of biologics—including antibodies, proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, vaccines and cell and gene therapies—and the conventions that govern their patent protection. Build life sciences-specific patent products: Partner with product and engineering teams to develop AI tools tailored to large-molecule patents—from protein and antibody sequence analysis to biologics claim generation, sequence-listing support and prior-art searching across life sciences databases. Embed with pharmaceutical and biotech customers: Work directly with in-house patent counsel and prosecution teams to design, prototype and deploy high-value proofs of concept for large-molecule patent workflows. Shape product development with biologics expertise: Translate complex large-molecule patent challenges into product requirements, ensuring our AI understands sequence data, CDR and epitope definitions, functional claim language, sequence variants, experimental data and biologics drafting conventions. Drive customer success in large-molecule patents: Lead technical sessions with patent professionals to ensure our products deliver measurable value across biologics patent portfolios. Identify emerging biologics patent opportunities: Recognize evolving needs across therapeutic antibodies, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid technologies, cell and gene therapies, biologics formulations and regulatory IP strategy. What we’re looking for Large-molecule patent expertise: At least two years of experience in biologics patent prosecution, pharmaceutical or biotech IP, or other large-molecule-focused patent work, with a strong understanding of the patent lifecycle from invention disclosure through prosecution, grant and enforcement. Technical life sciences foundation: Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or a related discipline, including an understanding of protein and nucleic acid sequences, antibody structure and function, biologics development, and how these translate into patentable subject matter. Strong biologics drafting skills: Experience developing claim strategies for antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids or other biologic modalities, with an understanding of written-description, enablement, sequence-listing and functional-claiming requirements. Significant post-qualification experience, including a senior or director-level accounting role. Strong technical accounting under IFRS; US GAAP experience strongly preferred Experience in a multi-entity, multi-currency group, with comfort across consolidation and intercompany accounting. Team leadership combined with the willingness to operate hands-on in a lean, fast-moving accounting function. NetSuite experience preferred; a strong systems and controls orientation. 🫵 What makes you stand out Experience in a high-growth, private-equity or venture-backed, or pre-IPO business. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. Our analysts are product specialists aligned to defined Checkout.com product areas and features. They work closely with Product and Engineering to identify recurring issues, improve product functionality, and strengthen the support experience for each product area. The team is primarily centred in London, with a strategic regional presence in Dublin, Mexico, Dubai, and Shanghai. This distribution provides broad coverage across multiple time zones and enables specialised support for merchants and internal teams. We are passionate about technology and use state-of-the-art AI capabilities to create better outcomes for our customers. We look for people who are curious, open to new ways of working, and eager to use AI as builders from the outset. Team members are encouraged to develop and improve AI-enabled tools that make technical investigations more effective and help accelerate solutions. Analysts acknowledge requests, investigate and resolve issues within their product scope, apply documented technical procedures, provide clear updates, and work in line with agreed SLAs and quality standards. Reporting to the FIU - Serving as the final 1st line approver for Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) and Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs). Audit & Regulatory Liaison - Preparing operational documentation and data for internal audits, external regulatory reviews, and inquiries from competent authorities. jobs.description: <p><strong>WHO WE ARE&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer - MENA
jobs.description: Who we are: Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our culture: We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. Location: Remote MENA - Preference for Dubai Please note: This role will require up to 50% travel. From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere! We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there. About the role: Sales Engineering is a team of subject matter experts who serve as the trusted technical advisor to prospective customers. You will lead prospects through the sales process by connecting their needs to Sardine’s value to win new customers and drive revenue growth. You will deliver best in class product demonstrations, fill out RFPs, and win over our prospective customer’s technical teams with your thought leadership and consultative approach. Internally, your insights from the field will help shape our product roadmap and will pave the way for future customers. You will play a key role in our commitment to customer excellence and allow Sardine to stay ahead of market trends. The SE team is a high visibility and high impact team. At the intersection of our Go-To-Market and Product and Engineering teams, we serve as the link between our customer’s needs and the Sardine’s capabilities, ensuring our platform is always adding value to our customer’s Fraud and Compliance stack. It's a great role for someone who enjoys learning the intricacies of a product to drive value to prospects, and leading through innovative problem-solving to convert prospects into customers. Variety, ambiguity, innovation, and ownership of complex problems are all big components of this role. What you'll be doing: Support Account Executives in identifying a prospect’s fraud and compliance needs. Prepare and deliver customized demos that showcase the impact of Sardine’s platform. Interface with Security teams to articulate our security posture and successfully complete security reviews. Complete RFPs for competitive opportunities. Create comprehensive Solution Designs that address our prospect’s needs. Collaborate with peers to improve all processes within the Sales Engineering team. Work together with our product and engineering teams to identify areas for improvement in our product suite and help prioritize and design solutions. What you’ll need: 7+ years prior experience as a Sales Engineer, System Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or similar roles Prior experience in similar roles within the Risk, Fraud, or Compliance domain Experience with APIs, a strong understanding of JSON, and proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Go, or Java. Bonus points for knowledge of web development principles and/or the ability to build internal tools using one of these languages. Strong analytical skills: you can dig into the technical details of a problem and turn it into a proposed solution Ability to thrive in a fast-paced remote environment working with global clients Excellent written and verba

We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars. We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses. What We're Looking For Technical implementation experience – you have a proven track record in implementation, technical account management, or solutions consulting roles (ideally in SaaS, PropTech, CAFM, or B2B software), with the ability to configure and deploy software solutions. jobs.title: UX/UI Designer | Intch
jobs.description: About Intch Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months. The product is used in 140 countries and is available in up to 20 languages. Intch has fewer than 40 people and four product areas, with three already live and one preparing to launch. Intch is rethinking how people and companies find each other and build trust online. Changes that made the interface feel more like a real conversation have already improved key metrics by up to three times. About the role Today one part time designer supports all Intch products. Since the company moved to a product based structure, that is no longer enough. Intch is now looking for its first full time designer. Product managers build and test early prototypes themselves. Around one in ten experiments moves forward. Your role is to join the thinking early, work through the problem with the product team and turn validated ideas into clear, production ready experiences. This is a hands on role with broad ownership. You will work across all Intch products and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers and the current designer. What you will work on Join product discussions early and help shape the problem before screens are made. Take a task from an open question to a production ready design. Design flows where the interface supports communication between people and businesses. Work on onboarding, profiles, discovery, paywalls and other core product areas. Cover key states, edge cases and handoff details, then stay involved during implementation. Extend the existing UI kit and keep patterns consistent across products. Increase the share of design work that can move into production without another rework round. What matters for this role Strong UI craft and a portfolio of clear, thoughtful interfaces. Solid web product experience. Web is the primary platform at Intch. The ability to explain your decisions through user context, not personal taste. Openness to evidence and the confidence to change your mind when a better argument appears. Experience owning design from an unclear problem through to launch. Comfort working with autonomy in a small product company. Experience in a startup, as a founding designer or in an in-house product role, would be useful. A practical approach to AI tools. The current workflow includes Figma handoff and clickable prototypes in Claude. Production code is not expected. English at B1, fluent Russian. What you get Remote, open geography. Time zone overlap with ~CET is what matters. Flexible schedule. Paid vacation, sick leave, and days off. A flat team under 40 where you can bring a worked-out idea into any product — and get paid for it if it performs. A design problem the market hasn't solved yet, in a product used across 140 countries. Real autonomy from day one. You'll sit in product discussions, not receive tickets. jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer
jobs.description: About us Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce. We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API. We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide. Role Summary We're looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to take the Photoroom app to the next level for the millions of people who use it every day. You'll own features from architecture to polished interface, ship weekly, and help shape the product roadmap while collaborating closely with Engineering Management, Design, and Product. Compensation: €90k-110k depending on experience + BSPCE Location: Paris, France, with an in-office presence 3 days per week. This is a Paris- or Île-de-France-based role, and we do not accept remote applications. We offer substantial relocation support (€10k signing bonus), including help finding an apartment in Paris and visa assistance. About the Role Build and ship new features for an app used and loved by millions, regularly featured by Apple, with a 4.8 App Store rating. Own your work from A to Z, from architecture and coding to polishing top-notch interfaces that deliver a delightful user experience. Ship a new version of the app every week, follow product usage closely, and make decisions based on fast user feedback. Shape the product roadmap and new features together with Engineering Management, Design, and Product. Raise the bar for the whole team through your code, your reviews, and by sharing your knowledge and experience, while learning or deepening your knowledge of technologies like Metal, Core Image, and CoreML. About You 5+ years of experience on iOS, mostly on consumer apps. Strong experience with Swift and modern frameworks. You care deeply about user experience and have shipped interfaces you are proud of. Strong sense of ownership: you take initiative and are comfortable making product and technical decisions. Pragmatic and iteration-driven: you favor speed of iteration over perfection and believe fast iteration is the best way to learn. Fluent in English (French is not required). [Nice-to-have] Curious about the latest trends in the iOS ecosystem and active in the community (Do iOS, Swift Connection, etc.). If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit. Benefits Regular team gatherings, including in-person onboarding in Paris (1-2 weeks), yearly company offsite and team retreat, quarterly in-person meetings (monthly during probation period), and social events like winter party and hackathons. 25 days annual leave + RTT on top of local public holidays Competitive equity package with BSPCE, giving you ownership in our growing company €1,000 annual learning and development budget for training, courses, books, and skill development Private health insurance Access to personalized mental health support , including 1:1 sessions with therapists or coaches, self-care tools, and well-being resources via MokaCare Sports and cultural activities reimbursement Language lessons (English and French) for those who need them. Photoroom is an international team, and we work in English. Relocation support (up to €10k) available for those choosing to move to France, including apartment finding and visa assistance. Note: Visa sponsorship and relocation support are only available for positions based in France. jobs.title: Alternance - Commercial·e / Sales / Business Developer
jobs.description: Le département Sales compte une trentaine de personnes réparties entre la qualification des prospects et le closing. Leur objectif commun : accompagner les prospects jusqu’à la signature du contrat. Notre cycle de vente est long et complexe (3 à 4 mois en moyenne). La particularité ? La copropriété doit voter à la majorité lors de son assemblée générale pour souscrire à notre solution. En tant qu’ alternant·e Sales Development Representative , tu es le premier point de contact et le premier maillon de notre chaîne commerciale. Ton rôle est stratégique : transformer l’intérêt d’un prospect en une opportunité commerciale réelle pour les Account Executives. Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre ! Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente. Tes missions : Réaliser les premiers appels téléphoniques avec les prospects qui ont demandé un devis sur notre site. Tu devras être réactif·ve pour instaurer rapidement une relation de confiance avec tes prospects, Comprendre les problématiques rencontrées au sein de leur copropriété, les convaincre que Matera est la bonne solution pour eux et lever les premiers freins, Organiser des rendez-vous de démonstration avec les Account Executive Tenir à jour le CRM Hubspot Participer à des projets d’amélioration de processus et d’organisation du travail Assister les Account Executives dans leurs missions du quotidien (suivi des prospects, tenue d’assemblées générales, soutien administratif…) Déroulement de l’alternance : Ton parcours d’intégration commence par deux semaines de rencontres avec l’ensemble de nos équipes pour comprendre comment nous sommes organisés en interne et notre vision. En tant que membre du département Sales, tu vas intégrer notre “ Sales Academy”  : Tout au long de tes 3 premiers mois, tu seras accompagné·e sur les techniques de vente et sur la compréhension des spécificités de nos produits et cibles clients (formations techniques, ateliers pratiques, etc.). Tu auras régulièrement des meetings individuels avec taon manager pour échanger sur tes difficultés et fêter tes victoires. Selon ta montée en compétences et tes appétences, tu pourras ensuite devenir formateur·trice, être force de proposition pour améliorer nos processus, ou continuer sur le cycle de vente jusqu’au closing. À la fin de ton alternance, tu maîtriseras les techniques de vente, les cycles de vente complexes, et les meilleurs outils utilisés par les start-ups. Tu participes au lancement de nouvelles offres, ce qui te permet de comprendre comment fonctionne l’entrepreneuriat. Les avantages : Les plus : Salaire : selon grille syntec Une forte montée en compétence sur les métiers de Sales, la vente complexe, la connaissance de l’environnement start-up et immobilier, Poursuite possible en CDI avec évolution en Account Executive par la suite. Wellpass pour faire du sport à petits prix Tickets resto (Swile) - pris en charge à 50% Accès à la plateforme Leeto pour avoir accès à des activités à prix réduit via le CSE Temps de Trajet Responsable (TTR) : 1 jour de congé supplémentaire par an, découpable en 2 demi-journées et rémunéré comme un congé payé, pour inciter à choisir des modes de transports responsables, Congés menstruels : 1 jour de congé par mois, pour mieux gérer les règles douloureuses, La base légale : Prise en charge des transports à 50% Mutuelle & Carte Swile - pris en charge à 50% Prise en charge de la prévoyance à 100% Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis Informations pratiques : Localisation : Paris 10e Type de contrat : Alternance (un ou deux ans) Date de démarrage : septembre 2026 Rythme obligatoire : 3 semaines en entreprise /

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information: www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:   We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success The Team You'll Join You'll be part of our Connect team, reporting to Rémi Fouilloux , Senior Engineering Manager. The team is split between Bordeaux and Paris. Together, you'll be building and scaling Mirakl Connect, an innovative solution that simplifies sellers' daily lives through a central hub powered by the latest advances in AI. jobs.title: Démonstratrice Lingerie - Printemps Lyon (Alternance)
jobs.description: Over Van de Velde Introduction Vous rêvez d’un rôle alliant élégance, expertise et passion ? Van de Velde, le groupe belge à l'origine des célèbres marques de lingerie haut de gamme PrimaDonna , Marie Jo et Sarda , recherche une démonstratrice dynamique et passionnée pour représenter ses collections premium au Printemps Haussmann .  Avec plus de 100 ans d'expérience dans l’industrie de la lingerie de luxe, Van de Velde est un leader mondial reconnu pour son savoir-faire exceptionnel, son engagement envers le confort et ses créations innovantes. En tant que démonstratrice, vous jouerez un rôle clé en faisant découvrir la sophistication et le luxe de nos produits à une clientèle exigeante, tout en incarnant les valeurs de nos marques prestigieuses.  Notre raison d'être : "We ignite the power in women"   Chez Van de Velde, notre raison d’être est simple et puissante : "Nous éveillons le pouvoir des femmes." Cette mission s’appuie sur nos valeurs fondamentales :  Portés par la passion  Nous respirons la qualité  Nous sommes authentiques  Nous nous concentrons sur les consommateurs et les clients  Nous sommes entreprenants  Ensemble, nous sommes forts  Rejoignez-nous et devenez membre d’une équipe professionnelle et passionnée, engagée pour l'excellence, avec plus de 1 500 collaborateurs à travers le monde . C’est l’opportunité de contribuer à une marque qui œuvre pour l’autonomisation des femmes et leur beauté depuis plus d’un siècle.  Missions: Vendre les marques en mettant en avant leur savoir-faire, leur qualité et leur raffinement. Offrir une expérience d'achat unique en magasin, où chaque cliente bénéficie d'un service personnalisé et d'une attention particulière. Accueillir et enthousiasmer les clientes en les abordant dès leur entrée dans l’espace dédié. Fournir des conseils personnalisés en lingerie en cabine d’essayage pour chaque cliente. Mettre en valeur les produits en assurant la présentation soignée du stand et en veillant à ce que l’espace de vente soit toujours impeccable et accueillant. Maintenir un stock suffisant pour le bon fonctionnement de l’espace de vente et répondre à la demande des clientes. Informer les clientes sur les produits, leurs caractéristiques et avantages, tout en partageant l’histoire et les valeurs de nos marques. Assurer une communication fluide et professionnelle avec l'équipe du Printemps pour garantir une parfaite collaboration. Profil recherché Vous avez une passion pour la mode et la lingerie haut de gamme, et vous êtes capable de transmettre cette passion à vos clientes. Vous possédez une expérience préalable dans la vente, idéalement dans le secteur de la lingerie. Vous êtes doté(e) d'une excellente présentation et d’un sens aigu du service client, avec une capacité à écouter, comprendre et conseiller efficacement. Vous êtes dynamique, autonome et à l'aise dans un environnement de vente exigeant. Vous avez une énergie positive et détectez toujours des opportunités pour mettre davantage en avant nos marques sur la surface de vente. Vous avez une bonne connaissance des tendances et êtes à l’aise avec l’évolution des attentes de la clientèle. Vous avez une forte orientation résultats et êtes motivé(e) à atteindre et dépasser les objectifs commerciaux. Notre Offre: Un contrat d’apprentissage.   Un environnement de travail autonome (shop-in-shop) avec un encadrement et un soutien personnel adaptés.  Une formation complète en lingerie styling et en connaissance produit des marques dont vous pourrez être fier(ère).  Une rémunération attractive, avec une prime trimestrielle liée à vos performances.  Un planning respectueux de votre équilibre vie professionnelle-vie personnelle.  Postulez dès maintenant pour rejoindre notre équipe et faire rayonner l’univers de PrimaDonna et Sarda dans l’un des magasins les plus prestigieux de Lyon. jobs.description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Le contexte   Nous souhaitons rendre le droit plus accessible et compréhensible. Pour ce faire nous construisons des produits à destination des professionnels du droit (avocats et juristes) afin de leur permettre d'accéder à toutes les informations juridiques dont ils ont besoin pour conseiller au mieux les justiciables.   Doctrine offre à ses abonnés la possibilité de demander des décisions de justice qu'ils n'ont pas trouvées sur le moteur de recherche. Notre stagiaire a pour principale mission d’assurer, en autonomie, le traitement de ces demandes grâce à son expertise juridique.   En plus de cette fonction première, tu interagiras avec les équipes en charge de la relation client dans le cadre du traitement des demandes des abonnés, tu seras sollicité·e sur des sujets quotidiens et de pointe (gestion du pré-contentieux et de la conformité, mais aussi recherches sur le droit de l’IA ou des données personnelles) et amené à conseiller les équipes produit sur les évolutions de Doctrine ou ses futures fonctionnalités.   Ton profil : Tu es à la recherche d'un  stage de 6 mois . Tu as une expérience de la recherche d'informations juridiques, une connaissance de la procédure et des institutions judiciaires françaises, et sais faire preuve de créativité face à une situation nouvelle. Idéalement, tu as une expertise en droit du numérique. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. jobs.title: Post-doctorat en interprétabilité mécaniste et diversité des représentations
jobs.description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Le poste est basé à Brest, au sein de l'équipe BRAIN (BRoader Artificial INtelligence) du Lab-STICC (UMR CNRS 6285). L'équipe travaille sur les fondements de l'apprentissage automatique (représentations, apprentissage frugal, modèles de fondation, traitement du signal) et sur leurs applications, en particulier en santé. Elle a récemment développé REVE, un modèle de fondation pour l'électroencéphalographie pré-entraîné sur plus de 25 000 sujets (NeurIPS 2025), et s’intéresse aux modèles de langage à diffusion discrète et sur l'interprétabilité mécaniste. Le projet ENDIVE étudie ce que la diversité peut apporter à l'apprentissage automatique lorsque le budget porte sur le nombre d'exemples annotés plutôt que sur la puissance de calcul. Dans ce régime, ce qu'apporte un nouvel exemple ne dépend plus seulement de sa qualité propre, mais de ce qui le distingue de ceux déjà vus. Le point d'entrée technique du projet est l'échantillonnage à garanties de diversité, et en particulier les processus ponctuels déterminantaux (DPP), dont la matrice de noyau encode à la fois la pertinence des points et leur similarité. Le projet explore cette question sur deux plans complémentaires : la diversité des données, soit le choix des exemples que l'on annote, conserve ou présente au modèle ; et la diversité des représentations, soit le choix des descripteurs, des contextes et des modèles que l'on exploite ou combine. Les premiers résultats portent sur le décodage diversifié des modèles de langue à diffusion discrète et sur la localisation de l'information dans les représentations des transformers. Le poste proposé porte sur le second plan, abordé par les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste. Page du projet : https://bastienpasdeloup.github.io/endive/ MISSIONS Les missions principales du poste sont les suivantes : Définir et évaluer des critères de diversité dans l'espace des représentations des modèles de fondation, en s'appuyant sur les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste. 2. Étudier le lien entre la diversité des données d'entraînement et la diversité des mécanismes internes que les modèles acquièrent. 3. Contribuer à la production et à la diffusion scientifiques du projet. ACTIVITÉS : Critères de diversité dans les représentations : • Entraîner et analyser des autoencodeurs parcimonieux sur les activations de modèles de fondation, afin d'en extraire des descripteurs interprétables. • Construire des noyaux de similarité entre ces descripteurs et évaluer, au moyen de processus ponctuels déterminantaux, si un sous-ensemble divers en fournit une couverture plus compacte que la seule importance individuelle. • Mesurer l'effet de ces critères sur des tâches aval en régime peu annoté, et comparer les profondeurs du réseau auxquelles les représentations sont lues. 2. Diversité des données et diversité des mécanismes : • Comparer les descripteurs retrouvés par des autoencodeurs parcimonieux entraînés sur des modèles nourris de régimes de données différents, et quantifier leur recouvrement. • Évaluer la stabilité de ces descripteurs d'un entraînement à l'autre, afin de distinguer les mécanismes reproductibles des artefacts d'optimisation. • Mettre ces mesures en relation avec les procédures de curation étudiées dans le projet, en particulier pour les modèles de langage à diffusion discrète. 3. Production scientifique et vie du projet : • Rédiger et soumettre les résultats obtenus dans des conférences et revues internationales. • Publie le code et les protocoles expérimentaux nécessaires à la reproductibilité des résultats. Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis : 🎓 Doctorat obtenu moins de 3 ans avant la date
